title: The Crucible
sentences: The most famous play about Salem was really aimed at 1950s America.
Arthur Miller’s The Crucible opened in 1953, during the Red Scare.
Congress was hunting suspected communists and pressing witnesses to name names.
In 1956, Miller himself refused to name names and was later convicted of contempt, a ruling that was overturned.
The play also bends the history.
The real Abigail Williams was eleven, not seventeen, and there’s no evidence of an affair with John Proctor.
